Theorem
[Uniformization Theorem]

1. ch1:1.7

Every connected $2$-manifold is diffeomorphic to a quotient of a constant-Gaussian-curvature model surface by a discrete fixed-point-free group of isometries. Consequently, every connected $2$-manifold admits a complete Riemannian metric of constant Gaussian curvature.
